name: Smelter's Step
description: Stride with the heavy sure tread of one who walks beside a pour of molten ore.

name: Ingot Fist
description: Strike with a fist hot and dense as a fresh ingot that dents whatever it meets.

name: Alloy Guard
description: Fuse metal into the molten skin of the arm so it takes blows like a plate.

name: Crucible Pour
description: Pour a stream of molten metal qi across the ground before the user in a burning sheet.

name: Bloom Strike
description: Strike a blow that blooms outward in a glowing flower of hot metal on contact.

name: Alloy Snare
description: Pour molten metal about the foe's limbs and let it cool into a hard bright shackle.

name: Fluxed Edge
description: Draw a keen edge of fluxed metal from the molten arm and thrust it through a gap in the guard.

name: Steelrain
description: Gather molten metal overhead for several breaths and let it fall in glowing drops of steel.

name: Foundry Press
description: Bear down on the foe with a hot dense press of metal that flattens their stance and their breath.

name: Slag Sovereign
description: Raise a wide pool of rolling slag and metal that burns and drags down every foe within it.

name: Cast Magmasteel
description: streams: Magma + Metal; pour the metal stream into the magma stream and cast a glowing weight of steel that falls on the foe.

name: Hazeroll Step
description: Slip away in a rolling fume of hot air that hides the true path of the body.

name: Ember Palm
description: Strike with a palm that billows hot air into the face and chest of the target.

name: Hot Eddy
description: Spin a small eddy of hot air about the forearm that swirls a blow away.

name: Plume Sense
description: Read the rising plumes of hot air in the field to find where a foe stands or hides.

name: Tornado Flow
description: Spin a slow tornado of lava and wind outward from the user across the nearby ground.

name: Embergale Snare
description: Wrap the foe in a gale of embers that cools at its edge and holds them in a ring.

name: Scorch Draft
description: Blast a scorching draft into the foe's guard to break open the line of their stance.

name: Cindercloud
description: Raise a thick cloud of burning cinders about the foe that blinds and chokes them.

name: Magmatic Cyclone
description: Gather a cyclone full of molten stone and loose it across the front in a roaring spiral.

name: Roaring Pyre
description: Fan a pyre of lava with the wind until it roars and drive it against the foe's line.

name: Windforged Inferno
description: Forge an inferno on the wind that rolls over the field in a wall of flame and stone.

name: Volcanic Tempest
description: streams: Magma + Wind; drive the wind stream down the magma stream until a tempest of ash and fire boils over the field.
